The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `50000` (see `Db2Builder.Db2Port`)
- Environment variable: `DBNAME=test` (see `Db2Builder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `DB2INSTANCE=db2inst1`
- Environment variable: `DB2INST1_PASSWORD=db2inst1` (see `Db2Builder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Mount: `/home/db2inst1/data`
- Privileged: `true`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Setup has completed.` is logged.
